label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: 21 Marketplace tickets were raised on 8 Oct, most of them under a new High-priority design and content review of 11 commerce journeys (MT-1586, due 12 Oct, 13 review subtasks). Seven AI-server catalogue fixes closed (PC-154 to PC-160), but three NVIDIA fixes were reopened from production (PC-148, PC-151, PC-152). Live chat build and QA started; the platform choice (MT-1578, due 9 Oct) went back to To Do. 22 items are past due, 20 of them untouched in 30 days.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: Eleven tickets were raised on 8 Oct: chatbot QA findings (agent request, name handling, layout) and Project Genesis and Careers page fixes. Privacy and security testing started, and the site-wide live chat (MR-754, Kunal Jangid, due 15 Oct) is in progress. Open bugs are 20, none rated. 9 items are past due: five June tasks in 'In Prod1', MR-1168 (Ready for Prod since 30 Sep) and two QA tasks due 7 Oct. Related products content (MR-1265) is still blocked.
